The activity panel no longer looks frozen while background agents from an earlier turn are still working.

- The panel keeps showing the last turn that used tools, so text-only replies leave it unchanged. Agents started in an earlier turn were left out of that view even while they kept running, so only the Main lane was drawn. Agents that ran during the shown turn, or are still running, now get their lane and a row under Agents, wherever they were started
- When text-only turns have passed since the shown turn, the header now says how long ago that turn ended, for example `Last turn · 7s · 12m ago`
- The panel keeps the last 400 calls. Calls from long-running agents could push the main conversation's calls out of that limit. The main conversation and agents now each get their own 400

## Install

```
/plugin install desk-look --marketplace KyongSik-Yoon/cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-asana@cc-desktop-mod
/plugin install desk-slack@cc-desktop-mod
```

Already installed: `/desk-update` (or `claude plugin update desk-look`), then `/reload-plugins`.
